headline: Pop Mart Reports Q3 Revenue Drop of up to 50% on Weaker Labubu Sales
summary: Chinese toymaker Pop Mart reported a 45 to 50 percent year-on-year decline in third-quarter revenue due to weakening sales of Labubu collectible dolls across major international markets.
why: Pop Mart is a prominent global creator of pop culture collectables whose retail performance reflects discretionary consumer spending trends.

impacts.name: Pop Mart
impacts.why: A steep quarterly revenue decline signals weakening global demand for key collectible product lines.

why_moved: The sharp drop in quarterly revenue and weakening sales of core products directly pressures the company's financial results and market valuation.
